scope: Durable per-open CREATE delete-on-close, deferred directory emptiness, rename/crash recovery and schema-7 backup safety. Not complete SMB/NFS conformance.

checks: schema 6 upgrades to 7 with backups in every file worker
four signed/encrypted dialects: per-open mode, last-close unlink, nonempty directory preservation, explicit disposition, notifications and rename
killed SMB worker recovers durable intents, deletes files/empty directories and preserves nonempty directories without restarting other services
offline metadata backup accepts schema 7, refuses unresolved close intents and succeeds after recovery
verified repeated logins do not exhaust the failed-authentication budget
signed NTLMv2 MIC authentication, UTF-16 create/read/write/flush/query/directory/close
QFid CREATE context agrees with internal file IDs across opens and distinguishes objects on one volume
authenticated srvsvc NDR32 share enumeration filters inaccessible and non-SMB shares
SMB share lookup ignores case, preserves canonical grants and rejects ambiguous publication without non-SMB shadowing
share access conflicts, exclusive/shared byte locks, rename with live handles, truncate and last-close deletion
signed related compound CREATE/WRITE/READ/CLOSE and credit accounting
directory deletion is nonrecursive; traversal/ADS/non-NFC denied; unsupported empty security-information selection rejected
1 MiB streamed binary roundtrip with SHA-256
unknown-session LOGOFF preserves the valid session; client-clock NTLMv2 accepted; excessive skew, bad MIC/proof, unsigned/tampered signing and malformed packets rejected
SMB credential revocation invalidates live access; re-enrollment and SPNEGO reconnect succeed
SMB worker kill/restart reclaims handles and durable delete intent without restarting API, identity or files
SMB2.1/3.0/3.0.2/3.1.1 signed/encrypted asynchronous create/rename/delete, live ECHO, CANCEL and CLOSE cleanup
per-open first filter/watch-tree settings, FIFO completion and events buffered between requests
native host writes trigger recursive watches while nonrecursive watches ignore descendants
recursive watches stop observing moved-out subtrees and do not disclose queued outside names
SIZE filter ignores equal-length writes and reports actual growth
LAST_WRITE observes new-file writes even when native CREATE and WRITE are drained together
first per-open zero/short capacity persists, reopening restores capacity; NOTIFY_ENUM_DIR has no partial records; invalid-only filters stay pending and cancel cleanly
directory/list-access validation and persistent shared security descriptor changes generate SECURITY notifications
portable DOS attributes, creation-time and EA changes participate in native notification streams
initial CREATE metadata produces only ADDED; subsequent changes still produce MODIFIED
recursive descriptor exhaustion stays visibly overflowed across requests and releases all watches on close
delete-pending directories complete outstanding watches without waiting for last-handle deletion
TREE_DISCONNECT and LOGOFF finish pending notifications with NOTIFY_CLEANUP before releasing keys
policy revocation denies the pending poll, invalidates its old handle and permits a fresh exclusive read open without retained watch/sharing authority
schema 5 migration backs up each file authority before adding persistent security descriptors
self-relative owner/group/DACL query, requested sections, required buffer size and READ_CONTROL/WRITE_DAC/SACL boundaries
ordered deny/allow access checks, MAXIMUM_ALLOWED and explicit-right intersection; existing handles retain granted rights
SMB denial enforced by NFSv3 READ/ACCESS, NFSv4 ACCESS, core API and WebDAV readonly aliases
ACE order, empty versus NULL DACL, implicit owner rights and OWNER RIGHTS SID
malformed offsets, overlaps, truncation and unsupported ACEs rejected atomically; ownership cannot be assigned to another user
file/directory inheritance with CREATOR OWNER substitution and multi-generation propagation; ACL follows rename
SecD CREATE persists protected initial ACL, validates ownership and rejects duplicate/malformed contexts before mutation
group ACE enforcement and membership revocation use freshly signed identity grants
schema 7 durability across process restart; replacement object receives fresh owner and ACL
NFS writer publication still enforces file DACL; WRITE and chmod cannot bypass SMB restrictions
DAV writer cannot bypass ACL; staged PUT retains restrictions, recursive COPY checks descendants and inherits destination ACL through private staging parents
DAV LOCK on unmapped URL checks parent create rights and persists inherited DACL

limitations: New source awaits GCC/Clang ASan+UBSan/MSVC Actions.
The original recursive notify diagnostic proceeds beyond DIRECTORY_NOT_EMPTY and fails with NOTIFY_ENUM_DIR at rapid subtree installation.
The original mask-change diagnostic proceeds beyond directory deletion but times out after 300 seconds; it remains failed.
The complete notification suite, leases/oplocks, durable opens, multichannel and full SMB/NFS conformance remain unfinished.
